scripts.dev: PUBLIC_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9999 PUBLIC_AUTH_MODE=local npm run dev -w frontend
scripts.infra:diff: : ${GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID:?GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID must be set} && npm run diff -w infra -- --context googleClientId="$GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID"
scripts.infra:deploy: : ${GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID:?GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID must be set} && npm run deploy -w infra -- --require-approval never --context googleClientId="$GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID"
scripts.infra:synth: : ${GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID:?GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID must be set} && npm run synth -w infra -- --context googleClientId="$GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID"
